name: Wenzhou Mahjong
description: Wenzhou Mahjong is a Zhejiang regional Mahjong variant associated with Wenzhou play communities. It uses the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while table profiles define specific win validity and scoring emphasis.

overview.description: Wenzhou Mahjong is a Zhejiang regional Mahjong variant associated with Wenzhou play communities. It uses the standard Mahjong draw-discard loop with meld claims and a complete-hand win condition, while table profiles define specific win validity and scoring emphasis.

history.origins: Wenzhou Mahjong reflects regional table practices in Zhejiang and developed as a locally recognized scoring and validity profile within Chinese Mahjong traditions.
timeline: 20th century: local table rules spread through community play.
Modern era: common Wenzhou profiles appear in documented rulesets.
history.cultural: It is played socially with agreed house profiles, often emphasizing familiar local conventions.
history.evolution: The draw-discard meld foundation remains shared with Mahjong while local profiles influence scoring patterns and acceptable wins.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand that satisfies the active Wenzhou scoring profile.
rules.gameplay: Players draw one tile from the wall and discard one tile in turn. Discards can be claimed for legal melds subject to claim rules and priority. A player wins when their hand is complete and their win satisfies the profile's validity requirements.
keyRules: Normal loop is draw then discard.
Meld claims must be legal and follow priority restrictions.
Winning requires a complete 14-tile hand and profile-accepted scoring validity.

strategy.basic: Shape your hand around efficient waits and avoid discarding highly connective tiles late.
strategy.intermediate: Use visible tiles and meld direction to infer which discards are likely to feed opponents.
strategy.advanced: Profile-aware play chooses between fast wins and higher-value routes based on wall depth and threats.
tips: Early flexibility is valuable; keep multiple suit options until the tile flow commits you.
When opponents reveal strong suit direction, treat that suit's remaining key tiles as risky.

synthesis.shortDescription: Wenzhou Mahjong is a Zhejiang regional Mahjong profile using classic draw-discard meld play with local scoring conventions.
